datasets.name: own_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS datasets,
       COUNT_IF(data_owner IS NULL OR data_steward IS NULL) AS without_owner_or_steward,
       COUNT(DISTINCT data_owner) AS distinct_owners,
       COUNT(DISTINCT data_steward) AS distinct_stewards
FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))

datasets.name: meta_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')))                                                     AS registered_tables,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(comment IS NULL OR comment = '') FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')))                    AS tables_without_description,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(comment IS NOT NULL AND comment <> '') / COUNT(*), 1)
          FROM workspace.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))                                 AS pct_columns_described,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(comment IS NULL OR comment = '')
          FROM workspace.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))                                 AS columns_without_description,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(classification IS NOT NULL AND data_owner IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1)
          FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')))                                                                   AS pct_catalog_coverage

datasets.name: lin_declared
queryLines:
SELECT source_name, hop,
       CASE hop WHEN 1 THEN 'Source API → Bronze' WHEN 2 THEN 'Bronze → Silver' ELSE 'Silver → Gold' END AS step,
       from_node, to_node
FROM (SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.weather_daily' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily' AS to_node)

datasets.name: lin_deps
queryLines:
SELECT dataset, COUNT_IF(direction = 'upstream') AS upstream, COUNT_IF(direction = 'downstream') AS downstream
FROM (SELECT to_node AS dataset, 'upstream' AS direction FROM (SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.weather_daily' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily' AS to_node)
      UNION ALL SELECT from_node, 'downstream' FROM (SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.weather_daily' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 1 AS hop, 'https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 2 AS hop, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS to_node UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 3 AS hop, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS from_node, 'workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily' AS to_node))
WHERE dataset LIKE 'workspace.%' GROUP BY dataset

datasets.name: lin_observed
datasets.displayName: Lineage observed by Unity Catalog (30 days)
queryLines:
SELECT COALESCE(source_table_full_name, concat('(', COALESCE(entity_type, 'external'), ' write)')) AS source,
       target_table_full_name AS target, entity_type, COUNT(*) AS events, MAX(event_time) AS last_seen
FROM system.access.table_lineage
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS AND (target_table_full_name LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR target_table_full_name LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR target_table_full_name LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR target_table_full_name LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR target_table_full_name LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%')
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: sec_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%'))                          AS access_events,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%')) AS principals,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          AND response.status_code IN (401, 403))                                                  AS unauthorized_attempts,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          AND response.status_code >= 400)                                                         AS failed_requests,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.information_schema.table_privileges WHERE table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))
         + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.information_schema.schema_privileges WHERE schema_name IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))              AS explicit_grants,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')) WHERE classification IN ('confidential', 'restricted'))      AS sensitive_datasets

datasets.name: sec_users
queryLines:
SELECT user_identity.email AS principal, action_name, COUNT(*) AS events, MAX(event_time) AS last_seen
FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%') GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: sec_failed
queryLines:
SELECT event_time, user_identity.email AS principal, service_name, action_name,
       response.status_code AS status_code, left(response.error_message, 140) AS error
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND response.status_code >= 400
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: comp_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT schema_name, table_name, policy_check
FROM (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
             stack(5, 'missing data owner', data_owner IS NULL,
                      'missing data steward', data_steward IS NULL,
                      'missing classification', classification IS NULL,
                      'missing table description', comment IS NULL OR comment = '',
                      'missing retention policy', layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold') AND retention_days IS NULL)
               AS (policy_check, violated)
      FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')))
WHERE violated)) AS policy_violations,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(retention_status = 'VIOLATION') FROM (
SELECT a.schema_name, a.table_name, a.oldest_date, datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) AS data_age_days,
       CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) AS policy_days,
       CASE WHEN t.tag_value IS NULL THEN 'NO POLICY'
            WHEN datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) <= CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) THEN 'COMPLIANT'
            ELSE 'VIOLATION' END AS retention_status
FROM (SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'weather_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.weather_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'weather_hourly', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'weather_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.weather_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'earthquakes_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'earthquake_events', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'earthquakes_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily) a
LEFT JOIN workspace.information_schema.table_tags t ON t.schema_name = a.schema_name AND t.table_name = a.table_name
                          AND t.tag_name = 'retention_days')) AS retention_violations,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(retention_status = 'NO POLICY') FROM (
SELECT a.schema_name, a.table_name, a.oldest_date, datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) AS data_age_days,
       CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) AS policy_days,
       CASE WHEN t.tag_value IS NULL THEN 'NO POLICY'
            WHEN datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) <= CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) THEN 'COMPLIANT'
            ELSE 'VIOLATION' END AS retention_status
FROM (SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'weather_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.weather_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'weather_hourly', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'weather_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.weather_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'earthquakes_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'earthquake_events', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'earthquakes_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily) a
LEFT JOIN workspace.information_schema.table_tags t ON t.schema_name = a.schema_name AND t.table_name = a.table_name
                          AND t.tag_name = 'retention_days')) AS datasets_without_policy,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(classification IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine'))) AS pct_classified

datasets.name: comp_ret
queryLines:
SELECT a.schema_name, a.table_name, a.oldest_date, datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) AS data_age_days,
       CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) AS policy_days,
       CASE WHEN t.tag_value IS NULL THEN 'NO POLICY'
            WHEN datediff(current_date(), a.oldest_date) <= CAST(t.tag_value AS INT) THEN 'COMPLIANT'
            ELSE 'VIOLATION' END AS retention_status
FROM (SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'weather_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.weather_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'weather_hourly', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'weather_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.weather_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'met_raw' AS schema_name, 'earthquakes_raw' AS table_name, MIN(ingestion_date) AS oldest_date FROM workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw UNION ALL SELECT 'met_silver', 'earthquake_events', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events UNION ALL SELECT 'met_gold', 'earthquakes_daily', MIN(CAST(created_at AS DATE)) FROM workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily) a
LEFT JOIN workspace.information_schema.table_tags t ON t.schema_name = a.schema_name AND t.table_name = a.table_name
                          AND t.tag_name = 'retention_days'

datasets.name: comp_viol
queryLines:
SELECT schema_name, table_name, policy_check
FROM (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
             stack(5, 'missing data owner', data_owner IS NULL,
                      'missing data steward', data_steward IS NULL,
                      'missing classification', classification IS NULL,
                      'missing table description', comment IS NULL OR comment = '',
                      'missing retention policy', layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold') AND retention_days IS NULL)
               AS (policy_check, violated)
      FROM (SELECT t.table_schema AS schema_name, t.table_name, t.table_owner AS uc_owner, t.comment,
       g.layer, g.source, g.classification, g.data_owner, g.data_steward, g.retention_days
FROM workspace.information_schema.tables t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT schema_name, table_name,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'layer', tag_value, NULL))           AS layer,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'source', tag_value, NULL))          AS source,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'classification', tag_value, NULL))  AS classification,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_owner', tag_value, NULL))      AS data_owner,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'data_steward', tag_value, NULL))    AS data_steward,
                 MAX(IF(tag_name = 'retention_days', tag_value, NULL))  AS retention_days
          FROM workspace.information_schema.table_tags GROUP BY schema_name, table_name) g ON g.schema_name = t.table_schema AND g.table_name = t.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema IN ('met_raw', 'met_silver', 'met_gold', 'met_audit', 'met_quarantine')))
WHERE violated

datasets.name: aud_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          AND status <> 'RUNNING')                                                          AS pipeline_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          AND status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS'))                                      AS failed_or_partial_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
         WHERE period_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
           AND result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT'))                            AS failed_job_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%')
          AND (action_name LIKE 'update%' OR action_name LIKE 'create%' OR action_name LIKE 'delete%'))
                                                                                            AS governed_changes

datasets.name: aud_runs
queryLines:
SELECT start_time, source_name, status, duration_seconds, job_success, job_failed, bronze_rows,
       silver_rows_inserted, silver_rows_updated, quarantine_rows, test_mode, error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: aud_changes
queryLines:
SELECT event_date, action_name, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%') AND (action_name LIKE 'update%' OR action_name LIKE 'create%' OR action_name LIKE 'delete%')
GROUP BY event_date, action_name

datasets.name: aud_jobs
queryLines:
SELECT result_state, COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS job_runs
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE period_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS AND result_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY result_state

datasets.name: aud_access
queryLines:
SELECT event_date, action_name, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM system.access.audit WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND service_name = 'unityCatalog' AND (request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_raw.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_silver.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_gold.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_audit.%' OR request_params['full_name_arg'] LIKE 'workspace.met_quarantine.%') GROUP BY event_date, action_name

datasets.name: dq_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.silver_valid_rows) / NULLIF(SUM(r.source_rows), 0), 2), 100) AS quality_score,
       COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.quarantine_rows) / NULLIF(SUM(r.source_rows), 0), 2), 0)     AS fail_pct,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.source_rows), 0)                                                          AS source_rows,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.quarantine_rows), 0)                                                      AS rejected_records,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(exists(dq_errors, e -> e LIKE 'NULL%')) FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine
         WHERE quarantined_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS)                         AS null_value_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(exists(dq_errors, e -> e LIKE 'DUPLICATE%')) FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine
         WHERE quarantined_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS)                         AS duplicate_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(NOT exists(dq_errors, e -> e LIKE 'NULL%' OR e LIKE 'DUPLICATE%'))
          FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine WHERE quarantined_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS) AS invalid_rows
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r
WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: dq_trend
queryLines:
SELECT source_name, start_time,
       COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * silver_valid_rows / NULLIF(source_rows, 0), 2), 100) AS quality_score
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: dq_source
queryLines:
SELECT source_name, SUM(source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(silver_valid_rows) AS valid_rows,
       SUM(quarantine_rows) AS rejected_rows,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(silver_valid_rows) / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows), 0), 2) AS pass_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(quarantine_rows) / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows), 0), 2) AS fail_pct
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS AND status <> 'RUNNING'
GROUP BY source_name

datasets.name: fr_kpi
queryLines:
WITH last_ok AS (SELECT source_name, MAX(start_time) AS last_ok_time FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log
                 WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') GROUP BY source_name)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(timestampdiff(MINUTE, last_ok_time, current_timestamp())) / 60.0, 1), 0)
         AS hours_since_last_success_worst,
       COUNT_IF(timestampdiff(HOUR, last_ok_time, current_timestamp()) > 24) AS stale_sources,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log WHERE start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          AND status <> 'RUNNING' AND (status = 'FAILED' OR duration_seconds > 300)) AS sla_breaches_7d
FROM last_ok

datasets.name: fr_datasets
queryLines:
SELECT ds.source_name, ds.dataset, l.last_successful_load,
       ROUND(timestampdiff(MINUTE, l.last_successful_load, current_timestamp()) / 60.0, 1) AS hours_since_load,
       IF(timestampdiff(HOUR, l.last_successful_load, current_timestamp()) <= 24, 'FRESH', 'STALE')
         AS freshness_status
FROM (SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_raw.weather_raw' AS dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_silver.weather_hourly' AS dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'open_meteo_weather' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_gold.weather_daily' AS dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_raw.earthquakes_raw' AS dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_silver.earthquake_events' AS dataset UNION ALL SELECT 'usgs_earthquakes' AS source_name, 'workspace.met_gold.earthquakes_daily' AS dataset) ds
LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_name, MAX(start_time) AS last_successful_load FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log
           WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') GROUP BY source_name) l USING (source_name)

datasets.name: fr_entities
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, d.entity_name, MAX(d.end_time) AS last_successful_ingestion,
       ROUND(timestampdiff(MINUTE, MAX(d.end_time), current_timestamp()) / 60.0, 1) AS hours_since_ingestion,
       IF(timestampdiff(HOUR, MAX(d.end_time), current_timestamp()) <= 24, 'OK', 'STALE') AS freshness_status
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id)
WHERE d.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY r.source_name, d.entity_name

datasets.name: fr_sla
queryLines:
SELECT start_time, source_name, status, duration_seconds, 300 AS target_seconds, error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log
WHERE status <> 'RUNNING' AND (status = 'FAILED' OR duration_seconds > 300)

datasets.name: qm_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rejected_records,
       COUNT_IF(q.rejection_level = 'ROW') AS row_level,
       COUNT_IF(q.rejection_level = 'PAYLOAD') AS payload_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT q.run_id) AS affected_runs,
       COUNT_IF(rp.replayed_run_id IS NULL) AS pending_reprocessing
FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine q LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT get_json_object(parameters, '$.replay_run_id') AS replayed_run_id
                    FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl WHERE get_json_object(parameters, '$.replay_run_id') IS NOT NULL) rp ON rp.replayed_run_id = q.run_id

datasets.name: qm_reasons
queryLines:
SELECT source_name, reason, rejection_level, COUNT(*) AS rows_quarantined
FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine LATERAL VIEW explode(dq_errors) x AS reason GROUP BY source_name, reason, rejection_level

datasets.name: qm_recent
queryLines:
SELECT q.quarantined_at, q.source_name, q.entity_id, q.rejection_level, array_join(q.dq_errors, ', ') AS reasons,
       q.error_details, CAST(q.raw_values AS STRING) AS raw_values,
       IF(rp.replayed_run_id IS NULL, 'PENDING', 'REPLAYED') AS reprocessing_status
FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine q LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT get_json_object(parameters, '$.replay_run_id') AS replayed_run_id
                    FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl WHERE get_json_object(parameters, '$.replay_run_id') IS NOT NULL) rp ON rp.replayed_run_id = q.run_id
ORDER BY q.quarantined_at DESC LIMIT 100

lines: Ownership, metadata and lineage for the `met_*` schemas (real data; `_edge` demo copies are excluded). Tags and descriptions are applied from the source YAMLs by the setup task.

Source API → Bronze → Silver → Gold is **declared** from the source YAMLs: the raw → silver hop is a Python parsing step, which Unity Catalog lineage cannot see. Silver → Gold and job writes are **observed**.
Access from `system.access.audit`, policy checks from Unity Catalog tags and descriptions, execution history from `met_audit` and Databricks job tables.

frame.title: Retention policy compliance (data age vs policy)
Changes to governed assets per day

lines: Quality, freshness and rejected records from `met_audit` and `met_quarantine`. Freshness SLA: a successful load within **24 h**; run SLA: **300 s**, not FAILED.
**Pending reprocessing** = quarantined rows whose run has not been replayed with `replay_run_id`. There is no other reprocessing workflow, so a row stays PENDING until a replay references its run.
